summary: Per-call AI model telemetry on the existing trade tape (Issue #12): agent_runs gains run_kind, workflow, provider, requested_model, fallback_used/fallback_reason, route_source, ok and cache token columns, three CHECKs and two partial indexes. No existing row is changed.

preflight.name: agent_runs has no workflow column yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'agent_runs' AND column_name IN ('run_kind', 'workflow', 'requested_model', 'fallback_used')

expected_changes: Adds nullable columns run_kind, workflow, provider, requested_model, fallback_reason, route_source, ok, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens and fallback_used (NOT NULL DEFAULT false) to agent_runs.
Adds CHECKs: run_kind is trade_tape|model_call; a model_call row names its workflow, requested model and outcome; a fallback states its reason.
Adds partial indexes for model-call rows by workflow/time and for fallbacks by time.
No existing agent_runs row is changed; no other table is touched.

verify.name: existing trade-tape rows untouched (all run_kind NULL, fallback_used false)
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM agent_runs WHERE run_kind IS NOT NULL OR fallback_used

verify.name: model-call index present
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_indexes WHERE indexname = 'idx_agent_runs_model_calls'
